newsitem.title: USA: ConEd Indian Pt, N.Y. nuke seen on line Weds.
newsitem.headline: ConEd Indian Pt, N.Y. nuke seen on line Weds.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc said it expects the 975 megawatt Indian Point nuclear power unit 2 to begin electricity production late Wednesday following a repair shutdown.
"The Indian Point plant should be tying to the electrical grid tomorrow evening, late tomorrow evening," a company spokesman said Tuesday.
The unit, located in Indian Point, N.Y., was shut Jan 27 to repair a feedwater valve. A restart planned for late February was delayed for valve repairs.
Separately, the New York Power Authority's adjacent 965 megawatt Indian Point nuclear power unit 3 was operating at full capacity as of early Tuesday.
